notes.title: Arthur Loves Watermelon Demo patch: 1.0.1 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
The first thing I want to do is thank you for downloading the demo. As some of you may have noticed, despite my effort to launch the game with the [u]"zero bugs"[/u] philosophy, a few have popped up from under the rocks. But don’t worry!

[b]PATCH NOTES:[/b]

- A [u]translation error[/u] has been fixed.

- A bug has been fixed that [u]prevented you from unlocking the 100% Demo skin[/u].

- A bug has been fixed that [u]prevented you from enjoying the third world’s soundtrack[/u], as it played the second world’s soundtrack instead.

- Some [u]songs no longer cut off[/u] when you die.

- The number of [u]watermelons per square meter has been increased[/u].
